    def rebuild_marginal(paths):
        """Marginal-cost view: edges already used by any current path are free."""
        E = set()
        for p in paths.values():
            for i in range(len(p) - 1):
                E.add((p[i], p[i + 1]))
        M = nx.DiGraph()
        for u, v, data in W.edges(data=True):
            M.add_edge(u, v, cost=0.0 if (u, v) in E else data["cost"])
        return M
